domain: A4-S1: open experimental anomalies favoring ICE-style predictions
oneLineSummary: 3 of 5 anomalies RESOLVED 2024-2025 against ICE-favorable direction: muon g-2 (Fermilab final June 2025 + lattice WP25 shift), CDF W-mass (CMS 2024 + ATLAS 2024 reanalysis SM-consistent), R(K)/R(K*) (LHCb late-2022 background re-analysis). 2 LIVE: R(D*) 3.4sigma 13+ years persistent, B+->K+ nu nu Belle II 2.7sigma. Bayesian: prior P(ICE validated)=0.20 -> posterior 0.08.
recommendation: Pre-register specific ICE predictions BEFORE 2026-2032 decisive experiments publish to avoid Lakatos post-hoc fitting: (i) R(D*) magnitude + correlated absence of R(K) split, (ii) B->K nu nu / K->pi nu nu ratio, (iii) Yukawa lambda/alpha for epsilon(r). Conditional P(recovery 2030) = 0.45 if pre-registered match.
references: Fermilab News 2024-09 CMS W-mass put to rest
CERN Courier W mass snaps back
caveats: Lattice-vs-data-driven HVP dispute remains second-order open path for muon g-2 re-opening. CDF 2022 still PDG outlier but most-likely systematic. Short-range gravity Eot-Wash null thru 0.06mm; next-gen 2026-2030 latent.
